item.description: The Religious Zionism party has presented a comprehensive plan to overhaul the judicial system, making clear that its implementation will be a prerequisite for joining the next coalition.

item.title: IDF eliminates two Hamas commanders who posed immediate danger
item.description: IDF eliminates Hamas commander Rafat Abu Zamar, who trained terrorists ahead of October 7, and a weapons producer as Hamas worked to rebuild its capabilities.

item.title: Poll: Nearly half of secular Israeli Jews fast on Yom Kippur
item.description: IDI poll finds 74% of Israeli Jews fast at least partially on Yom Kippur and 57% attend synagogue, including many who rarely attend during the year.

item.title: Murder of Caucasian crime boss: Police arrest additional suspect
item.description:
Police arrested another suspect on Tuesday in connection with last month’s murder of Caucasian crime boss Yanis Yoshvayev in Caesarea.
Police will seek to extend his detention in court, subject to the needs and findings of the investigation.

item.title: Sundor to operate flights to Marrakesh
item.description:
Sundor, part of the El Al Group, will operate two weekly direct flights to Marrakesh, Morocco, beginning November 16, 2026, on Mondays and Wednesdays, subject to the required approvals.
Introductory fares will start at $599 for a round-trip LITE ticket, including a carry-on suitcase and personal item.

item.description: Historic peace deal ends five-year Gur Hasidic feud

item.title: Poll: Nearly three-quarters of Jewish Israelis reject full Gaza pullout
item.description: JPPI survey finds 72% of Jewish Israelis reject leaving Gaza without a security perimeter, while support for occupying the entire Strip rises to 36%.

item.description: Footage from Lebanon: IDF destroys 32 rockets aimed at Israel

item.title: Haredi teen stabbed in Brooklyn synagogue
item.description: The incident reportedly followed an altercation that broke out inside the synagogue.

item.title: IDF recruit arrested during uniformed protest against Major General Bluth
item.description: Enlisted IDF soldier stages protest outside Central Command headquarters against Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth, accusing him of persecuting Tal Yinon Derdik.

item.title: Shin Bet confirms: Central Israel firefighter planned Hamas-inspired attack
item.description: Shin Bet says Mustafa Issa exploited his work as a firefighter to identify sensitive targets and contacted Hamas terrorists and Iranian intelligence agents.

item.title: Stolen cars found just in time for Rosh Hashanah
item.description: A targeted Border Police operation uncovered two Toyota vehicles stolen from central Israel.

item.title: Gazan reports: Senior Hamas terrorist eliminated in drone strike
item.description:
Gaza sources affiliated with Hamas report that Ahmed al-Batsh was eliminated overnight in an IDF drone strike on his vehicle.
According to the sources, al-Batsh served as head of the Northern Brigade’s weapons staff in Hamas and previously commanded the Jabaliya Battalion.

item.title: Fireworks fired toward London synagogue as Jews mark Rosh Hashanah
item.description: Five youths were seen outside Lauderdale Road Synagogue before two fireworks were launched toward the building; no injuries or damage were reported.

item.title: Pentagon reveals cost of war in Iran
item.description: A new Pentagon inspector general report reveals ammunition shortages, major aircraft losses and Iranian strikes on a key US Navy hub.

item.title: Sasha Troufanov reveals ‘switch’ that changed his Hamas captivity
item.description: Former hostage Sasha Troufanov recalls reaching a turning point in Hamas captivity, when faith helped him overcome fear and accept that his fate was in G-d’s hands.

item.title: The Red Flag: How far antisemitism has already penetrated throughout America
item.description: Listen closely: the canary has already fallen silent. Opinion.

item.title: US sanctions Russian banking giant over ties to Iran
item.description: US Treasury sanctions Russia’s VTB Bank for helping Iran evade sanctions and move frozen assets, warning foreign institutions to sever ties with the bank.

item.title: Saudi Arabia: 13 civilians injured in Houthi strikes overnight
item.description:
The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen announced that 13 civilians were injured in Houthi attacks on the cities of Khamis Mushait, Abha and Taif. Seven homes and two vehicles were also damaged.
Meanwhile, Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces reported advances in Al-Jawf Governorate, near the Saudi border, and said they were approaching the city of Al-Hazm in the center of the governorate.
Airstrikes were also reported against Houthi targets in and around Al-Mokha, as well as in areas of the Taiz, Lahij and Al-Dhale governorates.

item.title: Reports in Iran: Revolutionary Guards intercept US drone over Hormuz
item.description: Iranian Al-Alam TV reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' air defense systems intercepted a US MQ-1 drone in the airspace west of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Three Jewish teens assaulted on London bus in antisemitic attack
item.description: Three Jewish 14-year-olds allegedly assaulted and subjected to hate speech on a London bus as police investigate the incident as antisemitic.

item.title: US blocks Iran nuclear chief from IAEA meeting in Vienna
item.description: US blocks an exemption allowing Iran's nuclear chief to attend an IAEA meeting, citing UN sanctions and Tehran's lack of nuclear cooperation.

item.title: Norway weighs up to three years in prison for trade with Judea and Samaria communities
item.description: Norway’s Foreign Minister says the country could impose prison terms of up to three years for trading with Israeli communities in Judea and Samaria under legislation due this fall.
